content: CV crop-monitoring products commonly ship: fruit/produce detection+counting, ripeness/maturity classification via color+size, and disease/pest detection via leaf discoloration or structural deformity recognition, often claiming pre-visible-symptom detection. Controlled-environment ag CV applications span growth monitoring, fruit/flower detection, counting, maturity classification, and pest/disease detection -- these form the standard feature set; occlusion/clustering remains a known accuracy challenge requiring synthetic-occlusion training or depth-based methods.
